evidence: Official complete Giant shortcut places 43093 at the shoulder with its long local axis lateral.
Pinned 2303 LDraw 43093 reference mesh has nominal bounding extent 16.0 mm along Brickmen X and 6.4 mm across Y/Z.

female_geometry.torso_side: official Giant body socket geometry available in LDraw 10128; physical tolerance unmeasured
female_geometry.arm_side: official Giant arm mating geometry available in LDraw 10154/10124; physical tolerance unmeasured

nominal_dimensions.warning: Bounding extents are not pin diameters, interference values, socket diameters, or production tolerances.

shell_interface.cartridge_strategy: Design original Brickmen torso/arm shells around an explicit hardware keep-out and validated mating insert/socket rather than scaling the hardware with character proportions.

hardware_bom.substitution_policy: No substitute is production-approved until geometry, material, fit, torque, and cycle behavior are validated.

compatibility_policy.explanation: The two shoulder pins are independent local interfaces. A Brickmen torso may choose different shoulder-center spacing while preserving each validated local arm/hardware mating frame.
do_not_assume: 32 mm shoulder separation is required for arm compatibility
LDraw nominal geometry defines real interference or friction
a printed socket matching CAD nominal dimensions will have correct fit

required_validation: Measure physical 43093 critical dimensions from multiple samples.
Measure official Giant body and arm mating features.
Record insertion/removal force for hardware into each mating component.
Measure shoulder breakaway/running torque and axial/radial play.
Run cycle/wear testing before promoting any printed mating geometry.
Validate keep-out and articulation sweep inside the intended Brickmen shell.
hard_rules: Commodity hardware dimensions never scale with character proportions.
Reference CAD may define keep-out starting geometry but not physical fit tolerances.
Shoulder-center spacing is a body-shape decision unless a separate spanning mechanism makes it mechanically coupled.
Production approval requires physical force/torque/cycle evidence.
Candidate placement centers follow the selected Brickmen skeleton shoulder nodes; they do not force the official body's 32 mm shoulder spacing.
